The '''Union''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Prinawe]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Prinawe Union was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' as a reward for those who attended the Community Cantina Tour at New York Comic-Con in [[October]] [[2015]]. The fifth and last in a series of Cantina Tour rewards, the Union is shareable by players; they can give codes to other players so they can acquire the mount themselves.
